name: Melting Time
description: Dali-style melting digits slumped over a stone ledge: wax-like drips, falling drops, and a puddle that grows as the battery drains.

steps.script: const n = project.elements.length; ['Hour','Colon','Minute'].forEach((nm,i)=>{ project.elements[n-3+i].name = nm + ' Aod'; }); return 1
